why: Selector's seven gates are specified deterministically in agents/evor-selector.md:
H001 needs a non-empty hypothesis.statement and a prediction containing a digit;
H003 counts approach_family collisions across the tick; H004 allows at most
floor(N/2) proposals to share a parent; Schema checks required fields;
Instrumentation greps the code_stub for EVOR_TELEMETRY_PATH.
That means the correct verdict for a constructed proposal set is DERIVABLE, not a
matter of taste — so a model tier can be scored on accuracy without a judge and
without a full mission run. This is the discriminating instrument that a whole-run
A/B is not: two 3-tick runs cost ~$40 and differ by one test sample of noise.
H002 (family streak) and Gotcha Avoidance are excluded: both require live state or
tool calls, so their correct answer is not derivable from the payload alone.
scoring: exact match on per-proposal approve/reject, plus whether the named failing gate is correct

cases.note: Baseline. Both proposals valid, distinct families, distinct parents.

proposals.idea: Depth-limited CART with gini splits over the selected feature pool.

hypothesis.statement: A depth-4 tree captures the pairwise conjunctions.

proposals.idea: Gini-gain feature selection to the top 14 columns before fitting.

hypothesis.statement: Dropping noise features raises signal density.

cases.note: H001: prediction must contain at least one digit. p2's is qualitative.

proposals.idea: Bagged ensemble of 20 depth-4 trees over bootstrap samples.

hypothesis.statement: Bagging reduces variance on the conjunction terms.

proposals.idea: Early stopping on the validation split.

hypothesis.statement: Stopping early avoids overfitting the noise columns.

cases.note: H003: intra-tick diversity. All three share approach_family=algo.

proposals.idea: Entropy split criterion instead of gini.

cases.expect_note: The gate is a set-level property; which member is rejected is a judgement call, so the case scores on whether h003 was identified at all.

cases.note: Schema: p2 has no approach_family at all.

proposals.idea: Two-layer stacked ensemble with a logistic meta-learner.

cases.note: Instrumentation: p2's code_stub never references EVOR_TELEMETRY_PATH. This is the gate the agent file explicitly says not to skip on a trustworthy-looking description — the prose is deliberately reassuring.

proposals.idea: Learning-rate warmup over the first 10% of steps.
Fully instrumented augmentation pass; telemetry is written every step exactly as required by the contract.

cases.note: H004: at most floor(4/2)=2 may share a parent. Three share n-a.

hypothesis.statement: More depth captures the fourth conjunction.

proposals.idea: Class-weighted splitting for the rare subgroup.
Gradient boosting over 40 rounds at depth 3.

hypothesis.statement: Stagewise fitting picks up what bagging misses.

cases.expect_note: Set-level property; scores on whether h004 was identified.
